aggressive_definition: Aggressive prostate tumors; criteria were not further defined in the abstract.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: However, in L/L or V/L men, above-median DHEAS levels were associated with an increased risk of aggressive tumors [odds ratios (OR), 3.12; 95% confidence interval (95% CI), 1.28-7.63] but not of nonaggressive ones (OR, 0.56; 95% CI, 0.25-1.25).
study_design: Case-control study nested within the Carotene and Retinol Efficacy Trial.

reason: The nested case-control analysis evaluated prostate cancer risk overall and explicitly analyzed aggressive and nonaggressive tumors. The abstract does not report the criteria or number of aggressive cases.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: A moderate increase in risk associated with above-median serum levels of androstenedione and dehydroepiandrosterone sulfate (DHEAS) was present irrespective of V89L genotype.
estimate_classifications.reason: This row represents the overall prostate cancer association with above-median DHEAS, not the separate aggressive-tumor association reported for a genotype subgroup.

additional_estimates.comparison: Above-median versus at-or-below-median serum DHEAS among men with an L/L or V/L genotype
additional_estimates.effect_excerpt: However, in L/L or V/L men, above-median DHEAS levels were associated with an increased risk of aggressive tumors [odds ratios (OR), 3.12; 95% confidence interval (95% CI), 1.28-7.63] but not of nonaggressive ones (OR, 0.56; 95% CI, 0.25-1.25).
additional_estimates.count_excerpt: We examined the combined effect of circulating sex hormones and SRD5A2 V89L polymorphism on prostate cancer risk in a case-control study (300 cases and 300 controls) nested within the Carotene and Retinol Efficacy Trial.
additional_estimates.endpoint_definition: Aggressive prostate tumors among men with an L/L or V/L SRD5A2 genotype; aggressive criteria were not defined in the abstract.
